chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abān, from Yaʿqūb ibn ʿUthaym, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: We found a gecko that had decomposed in the well.
He said: “You are only required to draw seven buckets from it.”
I said: Then as for our clothes in which we had prayed, should we wash them and repeat the salat (prayer)? He said: “No.”
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a decomposed gecko is found in a well, and must earlier prayers be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a well in which a decomposed gecko is found. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that seven buckets should be drawn from the well, and he rules that clothing previously worn in salat (prayer) does not need to be washed, nor must the salat be repeated.
